remarks: Step into luxury living in the heart of Westport's prestigious Coleytown School district!This impeccably maintained residence offers an unparalleled blend of comfort and convenience in a sought-after neighborhood.From the moment you arrive, you're greeted by meticulously landscaped grounds and a fully fenced backyard, creating your own private oasis perfect for both relaxation and entertaining. Step outside onto one of the two spacious patios and bask in the glow of the outdoor stone fireplace, where you can enjoy enchanting evenings under the stars. Inside, the home exudes warmth and sophistication with its updated kitchen, ideal for both culinary creations and hosting gatherings. A versatile bonus room adjacent to the kitchen offers endless possibilities, whether you need a formal dining area, a playroom, or a home office. The main level boasts a cozy living room complete with a welcoming gas fireplace, perfect for intimate gatherings or movie nights. Downstairs, the partially finished basement invites customization, whether you dream of a home gym or a hobby space. Gleaming hardwood floors throughout add an extra touch of elegance, while three generously sized bedrooms upstairs provide ample space for relaxation and rejuvenation. With easy access to downtown Westport's many shops, restaurants, and entertainment, every day feels like a vacation in this exceptional home.
